libraw-wasm 1.6.0 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/libraw-wasm), ISC licence, by Yassine Bouane.
A WebAssembly build of LibRaw (https://www.libraw.org), used under the LGPL 2.1 / CDDL 1.0 terms of LibRaw.
Files copied unchanged from the package's dist/: index.js, worker.js, libraw.js, libraw.wasm.
Used by FS.decodeRaw in js/core.js to develop RAW photos that carry no full-size preview.
